Input: dataset \(\mathcal{D}\) protected attribute \(C\) , decision \(E\) , user-defined parameter \(\tau\)   
Output: judgment of non-discrimination judge, parents of \(E\) except \(C\mathbf{Q}\)   
1: \(\mathbf{Q} =\) findParent(E)\{C}   
2: for all value assignment q of Q do   
3: \(|\Delta P|_{\mathbf{q}}| = |\operatorname *{Pr}(e^{+}|c^{+},\mathbf{q}) - \operatorname *{Pr}(e^{+}|c^{-},\mathbf{q})|\)   
4: if \(|\Delta P|_{\mathbf{q}}|\geq \tau\) then   
5: return [false,Q]   
6: end if   
7: end for   
8: return [true,Q]

Input: dataset \(\mathcal{D}\) protected attribute \(C\) , decision \(E\) user-defined parameter \(\tau\)   
Output:modeifed dataset \(\mathcal{D}^*\)   
1: [judge, \(\mathbf{Q}] =\) Certify(D,C,E, \(\tau\)   
2: if judge \(= =\) true then   
3: \(\mathcal{D}^{*} = \mathcal{D}\)   
4: else   
5: for all value assignment q of Q do   
6: if \(\Delta P|_{\mathbf{q}} > \tau\) then   
7: randomly select a set T of \([n_q^{-}\cdot (|\Delta P|_q| - \tau)]\) tuples with \(C = c^{-}\) and \(E = e^{-}\) in subpopulation q, and change the values of Es from \(e^{-}\) to \(e^{+}\) to get the set \(\mathbf{T}^*\) of the modified tuples   
8: else if \(\Delta P|_{\mathbf{q}} <   - \tau\) then   
9: randomly select a set T of \([n_q^{-}\cdot (|\Delta P|_q| - \tau)]\) tuples with \(C = c^{-}\) and \(E = e^{+}\) in subpopulation q, and change the values of Es from \(e^{+}\) to \(e^{-}\) to get the set \(\mathbf{T}^*\) of the modified tuples   
10: end if   
11: \(\mathcal{D}^{*} = \mathcal{D}^{*}\backslash \mathbf{T}\cup \mathbf{T}^{*}\)   
12: end for   
13: end if   
14: return \(\mathcal{D}^*\)
